content: Godot4.7 built-in ENetMultiplayerPeer supports UDP host/client; PacketPeerUDP supports discovery broadcast. Recommend explicit host command validation and replaceable discovery/identity/transport. Compatibility renderer is documented suitable starting point for2D. CLI supports headless import/export and rendered execution; actual GPU performance and mixedOS LAN require separate evidence. Sources https://docs.godotengine.org/en/4.7/tutorials/networking/high_level_multiplayer.html https://docs.godotengine.org/en/4.7/tutorials/rendering/renderers.html https://docs.godotengine.org/en/4.7/tutorials/editor/command_line_tutorial.html
